verdict.rationale: AMD's official product page is a structured spec sheet with concrete values: configurable TDP of 45-120W, Curve Optimizer support, NVMe boot/RAID modes, supported OSes and max displays. That makes it a real spec sheet rather than marketing copy, but only the power element of the story is evidenced. Memory type and speed (DDR5-8000) appear only in a community comment, not vendor documentation. Missing for 10: vendor-published clock speeds, vendor-published memory support specs, AI TOPS figures, test conditions or methodology for any rating, and independent corroboration of spec accuracy.
